description: Description:As a user,I want to add a new training employee record, So that the employee training details are stored and displayed in the application.

elements.name: Add a new training employee successfully

steps.name: The User is in Employee Training Records page
the user clicks the Add Employee button
the user chooses Project Name
the user enter a valid Employee ID, Employee Name, Course, and Trainer Name
the user selects a Training Type from the dropdown
the user clicks the "Add" button
the newly added training employee record should be displayed on the home page

elements.name: Attempt to add a training employee without a Trainer Name shows a validation alert

steps.name: The User is in Employee Training Records page
the user clicks the Add Employee button
the user chooses Project Name
the user enters a valid Employee ID, Employee Name, and Course, leaving Trainer Name blank
the user selects a Training Type from the dropdown
the user clicks the "Add" button
an alert popup with the message "Trainer Name is required." should be displayed
the training employee record should not be added
